summary: A standing dumbbell shrug using the ACE split-stance version.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described joint movement; not measured activation, isolation or a primary/secondary ranking.

setup: Stand in a split stance with dumbbells beside the thighs, closed neutral grips and elbows straight. Brace the torso and align head and neck with the spine.
executionSteps: Exhale and raise the shoulders slowly, without rolling them or bending the elbows. Keep the torso upright and wrists neutral.
Inhale and lower gently, retaining the starting stance and arm positions.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the source-described starting position under control.
keyCheckpoints: Raise and lower the shoulders without rotation or elbow bending.
technique.breathing: Exhale on the upward shrug; inhale while lowering.

mistakes.mistake: Shoulder rolling or elbow bending during the shrug.
mistakes.whyItMatters: Technique differs from this source version; no injury probability is inferred.
mistakes.correction: Raise and lower the shoulders without rotation or elbow bending.

summary: A seated selectorized leg extension following the published HealthHub demonstration.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described joint movement; not measured activation, isolation or a primary/secondary ranking.

setup: Adjust the backrest to align the knees with the machine pivot. Place the pad across the ankles rather than high on the shins; start with the lower legs beneath the knees.
executionSteps: Sit upright and extend against the pad, stopping short of locking or hyperextending the knees.
Lower under control without the weight plates meeting in this demonstrated version. Reduce the load if the back arches.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the source-described starting position under control.
keyCheckpoints: Reduce the weight so the source-described upright position can be maintained.

mistakes.mistake: Arching the back to move the demonstrated load.
mistakes.whyItMatters: Technique differs from this source version; no injury probability is inferred.
mistakes.correction: Reduce the weight so the source-described upright position can be maintained.

summary: The ACE flat-bench barbell chest-press version, with separately attributed spotter context.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described joint movement; not measured activation, isolation or a primary/secondary ranking.

setup: Lie face up on a flat bench with hands slightly wider than shoulder width. Keep the feet on the floor and hips against the bench when unracking with assistance.
executionSteps: Lower slowly toward the chest as the elbows bend outward, stopping when they are just below the bench in this source version.
Press the feet into the floor and raise the bar straight upward to the starting position.
technique.finishOrReset: Complete the learned, assisted return-to-rack procedure; exact spotting and rerack steps are outside this brief extraction.
keyCheckpoints: Keep the hips supported by the bench and the feet pressed into the floor.

mistakes.mistake: Lifting the hips from the bench during this source version.
mistakes.whyItMatters: Technique differs from this source version; no injury probability is inferred.
mistakes.correction: Keep the hips supported by the bench and the feet pressed into the floor.

summary: The ACE shoulder-line grip barbell bench-press version, with separately attributed spotter context.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described joint movement; not measured activation, isolation or a primary/secondary ranking.

setup: Lie face up on a barbell bench. Place the hands in line with the shoulders and point the elbows toward the feet; learn the unrack with qualified assistance.
executionSteps: Bring the bar toward the chest by bending the elbows close to the ribs.
Press the feet into the floor and hips into the bench while returning the bar away from the chest.
technique.finishOrReset: Complete the learned, assisted return-to-rack procedure; exact spotting and rerack steps are outside this brief extraction.
keyCheckpoints: Keep the elbows near the ribs as the bar approaches the chest.
